description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Applied Engineering, Inc. is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to develop and validate embedded software and control solutions for electro-hydraulic systems. The role supports product development, system integration, troubleshooting, and collaboration with engineering teams and suppliers.
Embedded Software Engineer developing electro-hydraulic embedded software and validating MATLAB/Simulink control algorithms for drive and loader systems

Responsibilities:
• Develop embedded software for advanced electro-hydraulic systems and controls
• Support programming and development efforts for hydraulic drive systems and loader arm control functions
• Design, implement, test, and validate control algorithms for electric-hydraulic applications
• Utilize MATLAB/Simulink for modeling, simulation, code development, and system validation
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to define system requirements and deliver robust control solutions
• Troubleshoot and optimize software performance in both development and testing environments
• Support integration activities involving software, electronics, sensors, actuators, and hydraulic components
• Participate in product development activities from concept through validation and release
• Work collaboratively with suppliers and Applied partners
• Contribute to projects that impact communities in Neighboring towns and the greater metro area
• Apply your skills in a dynamic environment that values ownership and innovation

Requirements:
• Bachelor of Science in Computer or Electrical Engineering required
• Experience developing embedded software for control systems
• Background in electro-hydraulic controls or hydraulic system automation
• Demonstrated experience with MATLAB/Simulink
• Understanding of control theory, system modeling, and software development principles
• Experience with embedded systems, real-time software, and hardware integration
• Experience developing control software for hydraulic drive systems
• Experience with loader arm controls, mobile equipment, off-highway vehicles, or heavy machinery
• Experience validating and tuning electro-hydraulic control systems in laboratory or field environments
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Capable of working independently and as a team member
• Strong work ethic and unwavering integrity
• Excellent interpersonal skills and a learning mindset
• Curiosity, problem solving, and analytical thinking
• Effective verbal and written communication
• Desire to work on a variety of projects
• Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States
• We regret that we do not offer sponsorship
